BEHIND THE WORK

The contextMy contributionHow I approach itA note on the visuals

The context

An existing travel platform needs to keep evolving while remaining maintainable. My contribution spans its Angular frontend and .NET/C# backend as part of the team at Multiicon Ideotechnology.

My contribution

I refactor legacy components, services and API structures to reduce redundancy and improve clarity. On the frontend, this includes component structure, state handling and form validation. Across the stack, I work with colleagues to align API contracts and UI behavior.

How I approach it

Understand the existing behavior, isolate the change and review its effect across the interface and API. I apply SOLID and DRY principles, participate in code reviews and help debug production issues.
